[Hypothesis]

  • \(n\in\mathbb N\)，\(L\in\mathrm{ConsLit}_n\)，\(T_L\in\mathrm{Term}_n\)；一致文字集及其对应项见 27-df-term 及其上游 27-df-literal。
  • \(\mathrm{Lits}:\mathrm{Term}_n\to\mathcal{P}(\mathrm{Lit}_n)\)

[Assertion]

[Remark]

  • Terms are indexed by their unique consistent literal sets, so this map is well-defined.
